projectDescription: A multi-protocol gateway (S3 and FTP) that exposes Hugging Face Storage Buckets using a pure Xet content-addressable storage implementation.
keyFeatures: S3-compatible gateway (AWS S3 REST API) backed by Hugging Face Storage Buckets
FTP gateway with path mapping as /<bucket>/<key>
Pure Python Xet content-addressable storage (CDC chunking, LZ4 compression, BLAKE3 hashing)
Docker-first deployment with a single container and a MODE environment variable
Multipart upload support with idempotent retry handling
LRU caching for xorb chunks, file metadata, and reconstruction plans
Server-side copy via Xet content-hash reuse (no re-upload)
publicApiSurface: HFStorageBackend / Bridge (concrete Xet+HF backend in hugbucket.bridge)
S3 REST API: ListBuckets, CreateBucket, DeleteBucket, HeadBucket, GetBucketLocation, ListObjectsV2, PutObject, GetObject, HeadObject, DeleteObject, DeleteObjects, CopyObject, multipart upload
FTP protocol: list, retrieve, store, delete, rename, mkdir
